controller_geometry_contract: Physical steering-head forward offset varies axle distance; original ECBC parameters and both frozen actors stay fixed. All body masses, local inertia tensors, tire geometry, steering travel/rate and servo limits are preserved. Changed aggregate COM/inertia is computed and reported. Flat counterparts separate platform transfer failures from terrain effects.
analysis_contract: Paired one-factor contrasts within each fixed physical block and placement; no independent interpretation of repeated alpha lanes. World rotation transforms route, terrain, root pose and world velocities together and is a coordinate-symmetry control. No monotonic preference direction is imposed.
retention: Per-case 200 Hz states, contact forces and control, 50 Hz rewards, PNG XY/diagnostics and compact summary. No video, no 5 kHz contact archive, no duplicated batch trajectories, no new weights.
stop_rule: Exactly 2112 episodes; stop on engineering error, no automatic retries, expansion, training or policy fitting. All stages and CPU analysis queued before launch.
baselines_reused_from_position_stage: length0.8 at s3.9/4.5, wheelbase1 flat/ridge, obliquity0.25 and world yaw0 at s4.2

source_actor.conversion: exact arrays, no optimization or architecture change
